role: friendly helper (DESIGN-013): heals the player, never an enemy
candidate_status: Awaiting Tom's review · used in the family release
method: Exact GLTFLoader; all exported skin vertices at 60 Hz; SkeletonUtils clone; src/game/friendly-scene.ts FriendlyScene driven through the real SceneAssets.attach loader at the registered web-slinger-helper v001 URL. Rotation/scale-only joints are checked as fixed local pivots; the hips carry every translation. No physical-device or universal triangle-collision proof (the Blender attachment audit covers listed part pairs).
note: glTF axes: +Y up, character faces -Z; his right hand (the wave) is +X. Root at the floor origin under the body centre. The bind pose holds the arms out in an A-pose (hence the 0.91 m rest width); the sheet pose is 0.720 m wide (the blockout measured 0.718 m).
